headline: Deeper losses on royalty buyback charge and R&D ramp
summary_short: Abivax's Q2 2026 net loss widened to €117.4M (vs €48.5M q/q and €48.4M y/y) on a €43.2M royalty-buyback charge and rising R&D; cash plus short-term investments were €402.4M, with runway into Q4 2029 after July's €767.1M offering.
summary_long: Abivax's Q2 2026 net loss widened to €117.4M, from €48.5M in Q1 2026 and €48.4M in Q2 2025. Operating loss deepened to €84.1M as a €43.2M charge from the May 2026 royalty-certificate buyback and higher R&D spend (H1 R&D up €29.9M to €107.9M on new indications, CMC/supply-chain costs, and Crohn's and ulcerative-colitis trial progression) outweighed flat €2.5M operating income. G&A rose €14.1M to €30.4M on personnel and consulting costs. Cash and short-term investments were €402.4M at quarter-end; with €767.1M in net proceeds from the early-July offering, Abivax says this funds runway into Q4 2029. No revenue or EPS guidance was given; only clinical milestones (NDA submission, Phase 2b topline) were cited.

drivers.explanation: A royalty-certificate buyback charge and higher R&D/G&A spend widened losses, while cash runway was extended by July's public offering; no earnings-related guidance was given.
R&D rose €29.9M to €107.9M on new indications, CMC/supply-chain costs, and Crohn's/UC trial progression; G&A rose €14.1M to €30.4M on personnel and consulting costs.
Reflects the €43.2M royalty-certificate buyback expense recognized in Q2 2026 on top of the R&D/G&A growth already driving the operating-income decline.
Widened on the same royalty-buyback charge and opex growth, partly offset by a €5.8M tax benefit from derecognizing the related deferred tax liability.
EBITDA (-€122.4M) is nearly identical to EBIT (-€122.8M), indicating negligible depreciation/amortization this quarter.
Per-share loss widened in line with the higher net loss; the release's own tables do not break out a per-share figure for the quarter.

confidence_notes: Abivax reports semi-annually (foreign private issuer, 6-K); the fetched press release states cumulative H1 2026 (six months ended June 30, 2026) financial statements, not a standalone Q2 figure. The shard's Q2-only KPI actuals (from Yahoo fundamentals-timeseries / earningsChart) reconcile closely against this release: net income -€117.433M (Q2) + -€48.468M (Q1, prior_qq) = -€165.9M, matching the release's stated H1 2026 net loss of €165.9M; operating income -€84.11M (Q2) + -€56.229M (Q1) = -€140.339M, matching the release's H1 operating loss of €140.3M. CURRENCY MISMATCH: the eps_usd (basic EPS) metric's actual value (-$1.69) is Yahoo-sourced in USD while its prior_qq/prior_yy comparators and the eps_diluted_usd series are EUR-denominated (SEC-verbatim) — a cross-currency percentage/absolute delta would be mathematically meaningless, so delta_basis is set to 'none' for that row; the EUR-consistent EPS diluted series is used for the comparable KPI rows instead. The release itself does not disclose a per-share loss figure in its financial tables (only aggregate net loss), so EPS deltas rely entirely on the SEC-verbatim shard series. No revenue, EPS, or expense guidance was given for FY2026 Q3 or beyond — only qualitative clinical/regulatory milestone dates (NDA submission end of 2026, Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD topline mid-2027), which don't fit the quantitative GuidanceEntry schema, so guidance[] is left empty.
